test_overlaps_interval: test the IntervalArray.overlaps method to check if each interval overlaps with a given Interval
test_overlaps_interval_index: test the IntervalIndex.overlaps method to check if each interval overlaps with a given Interval
test_overlaps_with_na: test that NA values in an IntervalArray or IntervalIndex return False for overlaps
test_overlaps_invalid_type: test that IntervalArray.overlaps raises TypeError for non-Interval-like arguments
test_overlaps_interval_containers: test that IntervalArray.overlaps with another interval container raises NotImplementedError
